She from Montgomery, Alabama, raised in a house full’a culture. Mama was a civil rights lawyer, always talkin’ ‘bout standin’ tall, and her daddy, a Japanese professor, had her sittin’, listenin’ to samurai stories and learnin’ ‘bout honor.
